> *When trying to get from one place to another, you can end up somewhere unexpected. It's all part of the journey. In the meantime, savor every moment right where you are. Chances are, you won't be back.* 

The teleportation circles are halfway done by now. It's only a matter of casting a spell every day, one in their home and the other in the grove. Sabrine should be working on her own at Murry Hill, too. Corbianne comes when she's in the mood, because it's a day trip to Empire City — and that means she gets to go to Sesame Sweet. 

Though on one fateful day, the circles mess up and they end up spending a day on an island somewhere in the sea, with the remains of an old party buried beneath the sands. How the circles brought them there, she's not very sure, but it's wonderful all the same. They never find the island again, as much as they try. They learn not to try as much, and instead remember that strange day on an island they're pretty sure doesn't really exist.
** **

> *Don't be alone. Find your friends in the people who won't ever wish to leave you, and the same goes for you. It took me a while to learn this, and I hope you take to it faster than I did.* 

These days Cor is all grown up, found her calling as a cleric of the Ravens. She spends her free time either with her cousin Amaranth or at the Teel-Harkness farm, hanging out with Grimlock and helping take care of the children. Orphy is with her too, most times. 

Irynx, on the other hand, makes a trip to Empire City regularly, to visit the friends who stayed and catch up on the whiskey debt with Pinkerton, then the others across the west coast, where the Midasks and the rest of their friends have begun to gather. The old revolutionaries of Empire City scattered and settled all over Arcania. Thanks to the circles and all sorts of spells, a friend is never more than a minute away. Quackers is overjoyed to hear what became of the mothman egg, and Finn's movers are a fantastic way to pass the time.
** **

> *Even if they do leave... a part of them will always be with you. And you will take them with you, wherever you're headed next.* 

Irynx and Orphy sit together on the beach. For the first time in a long time, it's just her and her familiar, alone together with only the elements around them. It fills her with a warmth that was once the only thing she'd relied on for years. They'd been a team, Orphy had been the first thing she'd allowed herself to love after her family. A comfort, and in some ways a crutch. 

Before she was herself again and still stuck somewhere between being Seraxa and a nobody, she'd had him with her. Someone to talk to, someone who understood without judgement. She'd cast the spell with her stolen components, and summoned a familiar to remind her of the sea. An echo of a lonely girl seeking a friend. 

They talk, in that quiet way that only they can, but it's obvious what tonight is meant to be. She lights the incense, prepares to cast the spell. Orphy has already made his goodbyes with everyone else. Corbianne cried, but Irynx does not. She's known this would come for a while now. And after years at her side, like the smoke of the incense, Orphy fades away to the rest he deserves. 

Slowly Irynx walks back home, where the others are gathering. She knows what she'll walk into. There will be a space left for her, next to Sabrine and Roy, Ed and Will, next to Cor – open and inviting and without question. 

Not very lonely at all.
** **

> No matter how much time I get with you, or Orphy, or any of our friends and family, I can promise you our memories will last forever. Whatever happens, don't ever forget.
> 
> And though our summer is over, another will come soon. When it does, imagine me there with you, spending our days on the beach and gazing at stars that fill our hearts with wonder.
> 
> Because with you is exactly where I'll be.

** **
Irynx Berlio likes to be on the beach, to feel the breeze and hear the waves. She looks up at the stars that come to greet her good night. 

There are real constellations named and claimed by scholars, she knows that, but years ago, she ended up making her own. 

She looks up at the sky and names every constellation she can find.
** **

"I see you, Finn Midask. You made sure I'll always see you. And there's Vivica with you, as always, with her grounding perspective in the city where nothing was what it seems." 

"And Eliza... shining bright as always. To this day, the power of your hope remains a beacon. You made us all better just by knowing you." 

"Sonny and Fuddles, of course you'd be together. Still pushing merrily along, no matter how strong the wind that pushes against you, hand in hand." 

"That's Secel! Barreling through everything and everyone with a fire that can level mountains! And look at Nolan there, with enough arms to hold the world together." 

"Meorys, off on your own again? Ah, but I know that's where you were always happiest... Just like Eloise, the lone ranger who we all came to love." 

"There's the Speaker. That draconic gaze never quite fit with your kind heart, did it, my friend?" 

"Bones! Half man, half magic. Still living his own unique truth... And with him, Bo and Lucy, unfurling their colors for all to see." 

"My fearless Sabrine, my mild and lovely Ed, my loyal Roy, my silly Kukudh... and Sandigill, watching over them all. You made us more than a group of friends. You made us family." 

"And Orphy... what would we have done without each other? My best friend. You were the missing piece that completed my heart, and I carry you with me always." 

"Thank you, my friends... for every beautiful day. For all that we shared. You were worth everything and more."

**"Live a life you will remember"**

The Shadow of the Umbral Cup

    I had a long road ahead of me once the war was over. I was a mender; I was fighting in the war to rebuild what this city was meant to be about. In my first life I was building for the greatness of working men and women, we gave blood, sweat, and tears to get the roads laid out and the buildings stacked to the clouds. I died for that dream; my work was bastardized by business men hiring necromancers to keep the taskforce moving. At first, I was just another mindless builder. I saw the abuse the living workers were put through, almost like the top-hats wanted people to die just to make easier to manage workers. That’s what made me snap awake again. I came back full of rage; I beat back the taskmasters that would whip and try to break us. Andross Mortem may have been dead, but there was someone else standing in his Body, something else inside his Bones. That’s where you all met me.

----- scene 1 a walk down sesame sweet

“Good to see you come by Bones, so many have left for all over Arcania. How have things been in Kingsbridge?” It was always good to stop by Sesame Sweet to see Fuddles. Sonny has been doing a lot of planning and packing lately so I could only assume they were going to leave too. Thought it’s best to enjoy company while I have it, along with these shamrock cupcakes. 
“Things have been bustling. People got attracted to the new name on the umbral cup, but maybe I need to get a painter to put Gil on the front of it. They want to know who sandy is, givin me all kinds of funny looks.” I do my best to give her a smile, but I’m not the best at hiding what’s on my mind.
“Something wrong?” 
“I’ve just…thought a lot about Gil. And these headstones we all placed. The one in hampstead is part of what caused this mess, so somebody has to stick around and watch over them.” I could tell she understood, but looking to the room where sonny was working on maps for his next goal meant she knew she had a different road ahead. She got up to go talk with him while I habitually took out my matchless pipe. Good thing they invested in outdoor seating or else she’d have given me hell for smoking out the business. They finally came out after a couple minutes. Sonny looking spry as ever. “Howdy Sonny, heard you were planning quite a trip.” He wore a nice suit, changed to a traditional green for the vest, matched his skin now. His body may be a frog now but the green blood in his veins will never go away.

----- scene 2 back-alley bargain

“Yeah, but I always have time for my friends old man, the Mrs. tells me you were going to plant roots here in empire. We’re planning on living here. It’s just, there’s a lot out in different places that we can’t forget about. Anything we can do to help?” I Thought he’d never ask. 
“I’m looking after something important for Gil. I’ve made a good hiding spot for it and promised to keep it a secret, but to make sure it stays protected I had to find something solid, timeless.”
“Well, we got all kinds of magic in this town. Maybe before we leave, we can go through the library, or see if some of the cartels have something to help.”
“How about a bit of both?”
“Well, one thing at a time. Sis was always into magic and history, found a little bit of a tip involving a thingy. Thingies are usually pretty useful to start.”

There were a lot more guns than I expected. I knew Sonny was in cahoots with a lot of underhanded smugglers but I didn’t realize he heard a rumor about a local mafia like this. Some group invested in Ferrytown and Hampstead that had the leftovers of the lycanthrope torture supply from the gazette, among other magical goods like the ‘thing’ he mentioned. Why didn’t I follow Sonny behind those crates? This trolley doesn’t hold up against bullet fire. If that volt thrower guy got too close, I’d have nowhere to go. “I thought it too Bones, but in slang ‘it smells like a troll’ is code for not respecting someone and sending hitmen later!” That’s a lot of gunfire, oh boy. “You didn’t know.” Took me a moment to think, did sonny get shot or did he shoot someone? I had to move. The staff and twig were still saving my ass at least. Just gotta be faster than them. One hand using the staff, and one to outdo their mage stopper.
“I’ll keep that in mind!” That’s the volt thrower down, now where is- Ah, there she is. Damn that woman can pull weight, those are orcs. are they breathing? Well, they ain’t getting up that’s for sure.
“I got the, thing, sonny what did you say this was?”
“Ancient cryptid stone thingy, I don’t know it just sounded magic!”
“If we got it let’s get out of here you two. They ain’t slowing down.” There was no time for picks, this lock is breaking. The two horses would work for us. They really are a cute couple. A shame there wasn’t a sunset for him to ride her off to.
“We’ll uh, we’ll lead them this way don’t worry the library should help you.”
“Thanks, I owe you Both one, put it on my tab will ya?”

“These guys aren’t half as bad as swarms of redcoats. I could take this in my sleep” Fuddles sure could, I would hate to be on her bad side any day. Not as long as she has that axe, no, even without the axe she’s a force of nature.
“I just hope you’re still here when we come back, don’t go dying on us again!”
“Not planning on it!” Well, only one way to find out if this can help. One trip to the library, hopefully this can be a one book stop otherwise this could get dicey. At least those punks won’t follow me in there, I’d rather face redcoats than what they do to people causing a ruckus. This thing is pretty heavy so hopefully it’s useful.

----- scene 3 an avalanche of knowledge

Actually a little noisy in the library. Lots of footsteps trying to learn more about so much that happened near the end of the war. Months of research in here was rough but this is definitely getting somewhere. ‘Cryptids are attracted to historical events, a divination ability they have to just know when something memorable is going on. When you hear word of cryptids be aware of everything around you no matter how mundane or insignificant it appears.’ That explained a couple of things. Still nothing about this thing Sonny acquired for me. ‘Cryptids are also known to be attracted to places and objects that have survived for long periods of time. They can sometimes be found protecting ancient sites or treasures that have been used in historical events. Bringing such items into solitary places might attract cryptids, it is suggested that when transporting these objects to travel in large groups and move quickly.’ I went to the desk to see if the librarian on shift knows anything about this. Given the no talking policy I’ll just use a telepathy spell. “Hey, you wouldn’t happen to be studied on mystic items relating to cryptids would you?” he gave me a look and a deep psychic chuckle at the question.

“hahhahhah, yes. I know all kinds of things about cryptids and magical items. But that’s a lot of very sensitive knowledge. But I’m glad you’ve been thoroughly digging into BOOOOOOKS!” He sure was a colorful fella. He had a bounce to him, like a child’s ball. But he seems the type to know his stuff, only those types have the confidence to wear a fez like that. “I’d suggest that you be sure to respect them as part of the ancient magic of Arcania. Not all are reasonable.” 
“I reckon they wouldn’t be. I’m trying to find ways to protect something indefinitely. I got a bit of a passion project going on.”
“Passion, joy, excitement! That’s what we live for! When you find purpose it’s always good to make a plan and give it everything you got! It puts a smile on my face to see a friend of Gil’s trying to build on his legacy, it was always so sad before when he was a hero in death.”
“You knew sandy? How?”
“That’s a story for another day, and perhaps if you read enough BOOKS! You’ll come across the tale much like that vampire novel you’ve been reading. How is it by the way?”
“Ah, it’s a tense read. They’re about to sit down with Strahd and discuss the release of their friend. It’s also at the same time as the previous chapter where they had a jailbreak for the kid, so the big man isn’t going to be too happy. And that’s not a good place to have a ruckus.”
“I see, these are the kind of stories any brave soul is able to venture through. Who knows maybe you’ll be able to live forever, in a BOOOOK!”<:ArchivistDaysong:862360291119071232>

------ Scene 4 SomeFinn up

The new congress offices were a maze to get through. There was only one person I knew I would be able to get in touch with for a hand. It’s been about two years so some of my connections got tough with everyone moving around. Surely if anybody was going to help me with something as curious as this, it would be Finn.
“I can’t help you Mr. mortem. I’ve got a lot of work to do to make sure this government system doesn’t fall victim to all the holes in it, I’ll admit I wished I had more time in the original draft but we just couldn’t make that much time in the middle of a war. Now we have time, me and Washington have an understanding that we have a lot of work to set a strong foundation for this country. You understand right?” It was a surprise. He had always been so excited to head on an adventure. 
“Well, I guess I should have expected you to have these priorities in this office. Ah, that’s not meant to be an insult. I appreciate you’re working on the system to be better than how it was written at congress. Good to see we stand a little closer than we thought even if I still get concerned about some things.”
“I still think you worry too much, it’s safer this way. We can’t let tyranny be easily accessible and this is the best way to do it. It would take three tyrants to manipulate the system and that will only get more difficult after me and good old Washington ratify more definitions to the positions”
“And, what about this cryptid hunt?” Finn seems deep in thought, like he’s debating on telling me, but he obviously knows.

“Nolan uh…Nolan found something about that. He and Viv were tracking the mafia’s movements and found them heading out into the noir. Somethings out there, and but they don’t seem to have found what they were looking for.”
“Same one sonny brought me to?” Finn gives a nod. “So, they were going to take this to the noir. They must have planned to use it as bait to attract something out there, at least that’s what the library was telling me.”
“Andross, I really don’t think you should be looking for trouble like this. It’s not like you, you’re a hardworking man your skills and the knowledge you have could be better used helping us build something new.”
“Finn, Andross is dead. He’s not coming back even if I’m the spitting image of him. There’s just nothing that can change that.” I turned to leave but I could feel a tug on my arm before I was able to leave the door.
“You say you’re doing this for the mender, are you sure he’s somebody you want to be following? I don’t mean to sound rude but are you sure you shouldn’t just let his work go? He did enough.” I had to sigh and shake my head.
“There’s always more. Just like how the redcoats almost tore this whole city down, somebody else will come along and try to ruin all of it. I’m making sure what Gil built, what we’ve all built, doesn’t crumble. You do that here, making your policies. I have my own way of it.” I know he understood, he meant well with what he said but I can’t just up and tell him what I’m doing.


------ Scene 5 lamplight

The lamplighters office looks a lot better these days, more full of life than when we walked the streets during the war. Nolan seems to be bustling with a handful of recruits. Him and Vivica are quite the duo on the force, scaring a lot of people trying to take advantage of the changing world in less savory ways. They do a lot of good, a shame it’s been almost a year now. “We promised to not be strangers, right?”
“Well about time you came around. You live down the street from us so I’m surprised you hadn’t stopped in sooner.” Vivica always talked with a smile full of poise, she was charming that way which is probably why she has so many connections. Beneath that smile her friends know she hides a fan of blades. 
“Well, the cups been taking off and hospitality is a demanding industry.”
“At least you finally found your excuse to see us. You’ve been a friend to a lot of the lamplighters and it’s good to see old faces.”
“You’re…always welcome…”
“Thanks Nolan, sorry I haven’t been much help but trust me, I’m working on making the cup a good hub to help you guys out as well. But first I’m told y’all have a lead on this.” I showed them the artifact and Nolan went bug-eyed. 
“We…know that! The gangsters out by…the scar.” Been a minute since anyone was near there. That place was deemed dangerous and unstable. But Nolan has a good nose for dangerous criminal activity. “They keep… going in groups looking for something. But…why this?” 
“They’re after a cryptid, supposedly they can be attracted by historic knickknacks and heirlooms.”
“That’s dangerous to themselves, but if they get what they wanted I’d shudder thinking about what the risk is worth.”
“well, how far do they go?”
“Depends, sometimes they go days in there. The noir is a big place, a maze almost. Down in the scar can get really confusing.
“might…be weeks.”

I could only give them a nod as we prepared. Got a lot of grub and scrolls for the road. Who knows what hell we’re in for. Managed to catch Irynx at the grove. I…needed to ask the egg something.

---- scene 6 cryptid messages

This was my last chance to get some clarity. Irynx was aBout to leave and this creature probably had more know-how than anything in this city. Penny for your thoughts Mothman. “I, need to know something. Arcania has so many magical secrets, how…how can I live longer? Forever if possible…”
“Do you truly want this? To be ageless is, lonely. It is to watch everything around you crumble, what is there for you to gain from a life like that?”
“I have something that needs to be protected, something that could cause a lot of harm if it stops working. I…I don’t want another war.”
“But another war will always come. You’re as shortsighted as your friend you said wasn’t considering the path of this country. Is the stone really worth eternity if it will inevitably cease to function?”
“That’s why I want to protect it. So that it keeps working, so that it doesn’t make everything worse. I watched empire city go to hell once; by heaven above I’ll fight whatever I have to so I won’t see it again.”
“So eager to fight the change of the world. But if you aren’t swayed from your ideal, perhaps you should seek out the one they seek in the noir. To live forever, always comes at a price.”
“who am I looking for?”
“Uktena, timeless and surpassing many of his brethren. Not as savage as the others, but still hungry. If you are courteous, and feed him, he may share with you secrets. Be warned, he is in no way benevolent.”
“I wouldn’t imagine something like that would be. But I’ve made promises that I won’t back down from.”
“Then steel your heart for what is to come. You and your allies are in for much more than a simple hunt, or ‘shoot-out’ as you east-folk call it.” It thinks of the twig and my staff “those will serve you well, but not further than this battle.”

-----scene 7 Bones

We must have been in the noir for months. They weren’t kidding that time was starting to change here. We managed to stave off the loss of colors. Nolan and Vivica caught onto some stray parties of the mafia out here that hadn’t been seen in weeks. It must have been 5 years since the war by now, we’ve all got our own new tricks. We had to spend a lot of breath on some of the creatures out there since not every memory is a good one. “How much further in do you think they are? We’ve each lost some color along the way, too much longer and we’ll need to jump back.” I’ve thankfully managed to swap notes with a bunch of up-and-coming magicians with a couple big shots too. That book is actually worth something now. I can do all kinds of different things and possible is a broad subject to what I do. Figured a way to take more people through a dimension door, just have to hold it a bit longer which takes a bit more out of me. That trick managed to save us some time when we had to skip over cliffs and fissures in the underground caves.
“They…are very close.” I could tell Nolan has started using a locate creature. His eyes glow something fierce when he’s on the hunt like this. “They…know we followed them.” He pointed out and I could see several glyphs like what I used at the cup. This is going to be a tough one. Thankfully I still had that aura which let us fly under the trigger. I had to keep track of what all I’ve used. Level 6, spent. level 2, spent. Level 7, need that to get away if things go south. The staff and twig have struggled getting this far, only a couple charges between them despite the days of travel. We finally could hear them close by.

“That’s a ruckus, what are they doing?”
“They must have found the cryptid! We either have to stop them or move fast to pull what they want from under them.”
We pull back some underground moss and see a group of 10 mafioso’s rassling this horned serpent. I saw spells flying but they must have been drained like we were. ||“IS THIS ALL THAT YOU CAN MUSTER? SHOW ME SOMEONE WORTHY? WHAT CAN MATCH MY BRILLIANCE?”|| I saw them get closer, but they aren’t stupid if they evaded us this long why would they…at that moment I felt a pull as Nolan and I hadn’t realized how close we got, like our feet moved on their own. Vivica was already in cop mode, firing to apprehend these mafia and the creature. 
“Bones, what do you think it’s getting at?”
“it, it’s some kind of charm, you’re at a sane distance me and Nolan got had! Also it’s full of itself!”
||“MY STRENGTH IS UNPARRELELED, MY GLORY IS ETERNAL!” ||
The serpent wretched and thrashed helping us at least with the gangsters, but I noticed something in the back.  I found myself able to resist whatever this pull was but the mobsters started to notice us. I had to blast them out of my way with the last of my staff, still has that stroke of luck in it at least. I managed to get close as Nolan gave me cover fire from the goons peppering my backside. I was starting to go faint, the gunfire, the splash from their magic. There were a couple fireballs and the group shifted closer and closer except for Vivica. I looked the creature in the eye and spoke in it’s tongue

||“Uktena? I’ve come to make a deal.”
“A DEAL AND WHAT WOULD YOU OFFER SOMEONE OF MY GRANDOUR?||” 
I held up my staff. ||“I offer. This staff, it’s powerful, it bends time and space to your whim. I need to live beyond my years. Forever if I have to.”
“I HUNGER, HOW WOULD YOU PROVE YOURSELF WORTHY? WOULD YOU BEST ME? WOULD YOU GIVE ME A MEAL WORTH THIS BARGAIN? IMPRESS ME!”||
I hung my head for a moment, I looked to all my friends around, and these thugs at our throats. ||“a meal and a show, you can have the scraps.”|| I shoved Nolan back and vivica’s eyes grew wide as I held up the twig. It was charged enough.
“BONES!” I heard everyone shout as I snapped the twig between my fingers, surrounded by the muscle the riffraff brought along. Everything went black. ||“that was…IMPRESSIVE!”||


-----scene 8 for always

It had been years, but I hadn’t changed much except for an air of sorrow about me. Held a pained smile seeing the death in front of me. “Bo, you don’t have to look like that. I came to see you not some strange reflection.” I could already feel the tears trying to fight their way out. “I’ve uh. Dang I’ve had a lot in these years talked more with the Mothman, beat the local mafia, got everything worked out with Meorys, finished that book I was telling you about, it's a doozy. I uh...I missed you, Bo. always appreciated you but never realized just how hard it was without you helping everyone take a step back from the bustle."
A lullaby starts to emit from the shadow Bo as he holds out his hand towards Bones. A warm smile begins to bleed through the void of his face. Bones smiles strongly but can't help but sigh. "You've gotta be pretty busy like this. But it's good to see you. and if memory hasn't kicked the bucket we agreed on a drink?" He gives a chuckle still in some disbelief. "But i think it'll be on my tab for now" he holds up a single drachmae. Shadow Bo stands there... Still holding his hand out.... Waiting. The lullaby gets louder... Slowly.  Had to rubs my eyes. "Can you not talk until cross over? I uh...might have some bad news on that." his smile fades. "It...it would mean a lot to hear your voice again..." he flips the drachmae into his hand. The drachma fell through the shadow Bo's hand to the ground. I cringed. "That uh. not how it works anymore?" my face covered with worry at the thought. Tired of waiting... Shadow Bo lunges forward, reaching his hand into my chest. Shadow Bo grabs hold of the prosthetic heart as the world around faded into a pitch black. Save for a small light, growing closer.

A familiar giggling races around in my head. All at once, a bright light flashed. Before I can make heads or tails of the situation... I find myself sitting on a flying carpet. Lucy booping my nose is the first sensation and sight i see and feel as i comes to. Bo, sitting across from me, holding two mugs. With a wide smile, he holds one towards me.
"Sorry i'm late on that drink." He chuckles. I can't help but tear up and take the drink with a cheer. "
"Well. I'm glad it came eventually." 
"So what’s the bad news?" Bo asks as a happy tear rolls down his cheek. Lucy landed on my shoulder and nuzzled my cheek while purring
"I'm...mostly just stopping in to see you again. and I don't know if...when I'll be back. It's part of what I couldn't tell you before. but I guess if you're here, this is the best place to share secrets." I pat lucy and Bo looks at me... More confused than ever. 
"What’s on your mind, my friend?" Bo takes a swig as he waited. "What’s this about... Not knowing?" Bo sipped his drink again and smiles. Lucy curled up into my lap. I drank and smiled at the trick of a refilling mug, and took in at the scenery of the river styx. 
"It's uh...a favor I'm doing for Gil. He had us place foundation stones of how we wanted the city to be. They would help it grow, like when you tie a tree to a support. make sure it grows straight and clean." I took a long drink, I needed it. "And I want to be there as long as i can to make sure it stays that way. So... once I go back, I'll be immortal Bo." I couldn’t stop myself but rubbing my thumb on the cup anxiously. A happy expression spreads across his face. "What's with the smile? We might never see each other again."

"Yer point?" He says with confidence. "My friend, I'll ne'er haf ta worry again.... You'll be alive and well, changing the world! What’s there to not be happy about?"
His tired eyes lock with Bo's. "I guess there's that." he smiles. "I just... wanted you to know where i was so you didn't get caught unaware, I suppose. but I’m going to miss you." I regaled the script on the stone as Bo listens with a smile. 
"I'm happy... for you, my friend." He words pause. He begins to chug his drink then raises it into the air. "To a full life... We both have a long road ahead, you in life... me in death!" Lucy smiles up at Bones. "Together, we will restore the balance!" Bo cheers. Bones raises his mug to the cheer. 
"The best of friends, different but in the best ways." Bo smiles, lucy giggles... And Bones' view fades into black again. He finds himself standing back in the land of the living. A small pain wrecks his chest as shadow Bo pulls his hand out, leaving the heart behind. A moment passes for Bones to compose himself and the shadow Bo holds his fist out towards Bones who connects with it. "May we meet again. when the world is better." The shadow Bo begins to laugh, and he smiles. Nodding his head to Bones, he grabs hold of Bones' arm with his other hand and pulls. my fist opens and he drops a small crystal into it before the shadow Bo is swept away with the wind. Bones waves goodbye and strings the crystal around his neck

-----final scene the old watering hole

Nolan and viv must have carried me back to the cup. When I was coming to, they seemed to be trying to gather components for a rez and panicking. “What was he thinking? What was he trying to bargain for?” Vivica sounded like she was struggling to make sense of my actions. “He’s awake! BONES WHAT WERE YOU THINKING!” I can still feel the sting of that backhand, but in all fairness, she was justified. Nobody knew I was coming back. It was all spur of the moment. She stood up and I pulled myself off the floor. “I think it worked, I wouldn’t come back if it hadn’t.”
“…we got a diamond… it wasn’t cheap.” It was a but intimidating to see Nolan pointing at me like that. He was a force to be reckoned with and I think I now owe him a hefty price.
“I’ll uh, pay you back for the trouble.” We all exchanged the pleasantries and shook on a agreements to help whenever I could. I owed the lamplighters a lot for this. I’d spent ages gathering info for them. Several tried to track down the stone and all of them either moved on or were forced out. The cup was the hub gil wanted it to be. But after so many years people looked to other and more fancy places, the city built up and around until the cup was nothing more than a shack. But I was still there, a shadow in the halls. Intruders still came to try and find the stone but I’ve spent every coin I could spare making enough glyphs to prevent harm to it. And a legend spread throughout the town of a ghost in this building with a dozen different stories about why it’s there. But until someone comes and puts me down for good, I will be here. Waiting.
